Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:



Nope.
Ian Forestal doesn't *have* any disciplines other than AUS DOM THA.
And Haven Affinity is worded as:
"...he or she may play combat cards in the resulting combat as if
all of his or her Disciplines were at the superior level."

"All of Ian Forestal's Disciplines" are AUS DOM THA. So Haven
Affinity wouldn't do anything for Ian, unless he gained some
inferior disciplines without skill cards (since if he uses a skill
card, his own ability puts it at superior).
